note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, two top texts and one number pop, so 5 graphics and Family Reach's own closing card. Every other row is captions only, as Family Reach patient stories run simple.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “They paid our mortgage.” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third, over Kristen.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:06 for 3 s, lower left: “Kristen Benjamin” / Paisley’s mom.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:06 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Paisley’s mom under the name.

mg.title: Never the word

text.main: Never was the word cancer mentioned to me at any point.

mg.cue: Top text on “Never was the word cancer mentioned to me at any point.” as she says it.
mg.use: Top third, on as she says “Never was the word cancer”, off at the end of the line. Keep captions on.

mg.title: 44 days
mg.cue: Number pop over the photo on “44 days”: 44 days in the hospital.
mg.use: Over the hospital photo as she says “44 days”. Top third. Out before she is back on camera.

mg.title: One month

text.main: one month that we didn’t have to stress

mg.cue: Top text on “one month that we didn’t have to stress” as she says it.
mg.use: Top third, on as she says “one month”, off after “stress”. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Family Reach’s own closing card. Nothing added to it.
mg.src: Family Reach's own closing card, new brand (Video closeout (15).mp4 from Ansley, Drive, 15 Sep 2026; endcards/index.json).
mg.use: Right after “Because cancer is hard enough.” Hold it to the end. Music only under it, no voices.
